clue.text: Ex-BR chef, possibly, who makes piecrusts

parts.note: ex means former, so the past
BR was British Rail, and RY is the usual short form of railway
a chef is one kind of cook

explanation.surface: A former British Rail caterer now earns a living making pies.
explanation.walkthrough: BR is British Rail, the old nationalised railway; it stands for the railway, abbreviated RY. 'Ex' gives PAST, 'chef, possibly' gives COOK.
explanation.definitionFit: Piecrusts are pastry, and the kitchen hand who makes them is the pastry specialist.

clue.text: Set up an area for game

a playing field, such as a football or cricket ground

parts.note: heartily usually means enthusiastically, but here it means to do with the heart: heart patients receive this kind of treatment

clue.text: Donald's a right queer sort of flier

parts.note: taken as written, the S included
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' signals an anagram of DONALDS, A, R (right) and QUEER.

parts.note: re means about or concerning

taken as written
